verses.text: By David. LORD, take up my cause against those who accuse me. Fight against those who fight me.
Take up your shields, large and small, and stand up to help me.
Raise your spear and block those chasing me. Tell my soul, “I am the one who saves you.”
Let those who want me dead be put to shame and dishonor. Turn back and confuse those who plot my ruin.
Let them scatter like chaff in the wind, with the LORD’s angel driving them away.
Let their path be dark and slippery, with the LORD’s angel chasing them.
For no reason they hid a net for me in a pit. For no reason they dug a pit to take my life.
Let ruin overtake them by surprise. Let them get caught in the net they hid and fall into their own ruin.
Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and celebrate his rescue.
Every bone in my body will say, “LORD, who is like you? You rescue the poor from people too strong for them and save the poor and needy from those who rob them.”
False witnesses stand up against me and question me about things I know nothing about.
They repay my good with evil, leaving me heartbroken.
When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and humbled myself by fasting. My prayer came back to my own heart.
I treated them as I would a friend or a brother. I bowed my head in grief as if I were mourning my mother.
But when I was in trouble they celebrated and gathered against me. Attackers came together without my knowing, and they tore at me without stopping.
Like godless people mocking at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you stand by and watch? Rescue me from their attacks. Save my precious life from the lions.
I’ll thank you in the great assembly and praise you among crowds of people.
Don’t let those who are my enemies without cause celebrate my downfall. Don’t let those who hate me for no reason wink at each other.
They speak no words of peace. They make up lies against people who live quietly in the land.
They open their mouths wide against me and say, “Aha! Aha! We saw it ourselves!”
But you saw it, LORD. Don’t stay silent. Lord, don’t stay far from me.
Wake up and rise to defend me, my God! My Lord, take up my case!
Clear my name, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
Don’t let them think, “Aha! This is exactly what we wanted!” Don’t let them say, “We swallowed him up!”
Let those who celebrate my trouble be put to shame and confusion together. Dress those who boast over me in shame and dishonor.
Let those who stand with me in my just cause shout for joy. Let them keep saying, “Great is the LORD, who delights in his servant’s well-being!”
I’ll speak of your righteousness and sing your praise all day long.
